result.stdout:
Description:
  Takes a snapshot of a git repository's branches, tags, remotes, HEAD and (optionally) working tree, and restores it later.

Usage:
  gitsnapshotter [command] [options]

Options:
  -?, -h, --help  Show help and usage information
  --version       Show version information

Commands:
  snapshot <repository>                 Take a snapshot. Prints JSON, or writes it to the --output file.
  restore <repository> <snapshot-file>  Restore a snapshot.
  diff <repository> <snapshot-file>     List what changed in the repository since the snapshot was taken.
  help <command>                        Show help for gitsnapshotter or one of its commands.

Description:
  Take a snapshot. Prints JSON, or writes it to the --output file.

Usage:
  gitsnapshotter snapshot <repository> [options]

Arguments:
  <repository>  Path to the git repository.

Options:
  -o, --output <file>     Write the snapshot to this file instead of printing it.
  --include-working-tree  Also record the index and the working tree.
  -?, -h, --help          Show help and usage information

Description:
  Restore a snapshot.

Usage:
  gitsnapshotter restore <repository> <snapshot-file> [options]

Arguments:
  <repository>     Path to the git repository.
  <snapshot-file>  A snapshot written by the snapshot command.

Options:
  --force         Overwrite uncommitted changes.
  --dry-run       Only list what would change.
  -?, -h, --help  Show help and usage information
